version: LOCK 10 V1 (8 Nov 2026) - chapter 1: the sealed purse
builds_on: LOCK 1 (trust, gate), LOCK 2 (quay, money-changers), LOCK 7 (hours). Placeholders: {n}.
quay_button: Karim has a job for you

offer.title: Karim the money-changer
offer.text: Karim has heard you are honest. He holds out a heavy purse sewn shut with a wax seal: “Take this to Abbas, the caravan master at the Gate of Trust. Four coins for your trouble.”

coin.title: A coin on the stones
coin.text: Halfway up the street the seam splits a little. One silver coin drops and rolls to your foot. Nobody is looking.
coin.back_in: Push it back into the purse

carrying: You are carrying Karim's sealed purse to the Gate of Trust.

deliver.title: Abbas the caravan master
deliver.honest: Abbas cuts the seal and counts in front of you. Every coin is there. He nods slowly: “Karim chose well.” You go back and Karim pays you four coins.
deliver.kept: Abbas cuts the seal and counts. He counts again. “One short.” By evening Karim has heard. He pays you nothing and says nothing.

deen: Allah commands you to render trusts to whom they are due (Quran 4:58)
